business_requirements.name: Real-Time Inventory Visibility
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall provide accurate, real-time visibility of sellable item quantities and availability status for specific store locations to prevent overselling and ensure order feasibility.
business_requirements.business_objective: Eliminate discrepancies between customer expectations and physical inventory to maintain trust and operational efficiency.
business_requirements.business_value: Prevents revenue loss from overselling, reduces customer dissatisfaction, and optimizes order allocation efficiency.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR explicitly states the purpose is to prevent overselling and validate order feasibility based on actual inventory levels.

origin.description: The current, validated quantity of each sellable item (SKU) at a specific store location, including status flags for availability, partial stock, or temporary unavailability.

success_measures.measure: Zero overselling incidents per transaction cycle

policies_and_constraints: Stock counts must reflect actual inventory at the specific store location.
Orders cannot be allocated for SKUs showing zero or negative availability.
assumptions: Store Partners maintain accurate local inventory levels via POS synchronization.
Data latency thresholds are acceptable for real-time decision making.
risks_and_dependencies: Data discrepancies between Store POS and Platform Engine.

business_requirements.name: Dynamic Order Allocation
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall allocate orders to specific store locations based on real-time stock depth and availability status to optimize fulfillment efficiency.
business_requirements.business_objective: Ensure orders are fulfilled from the most appropriate store based on current inventory capacity.
business_requirements.business_value: Optimizes logistics costs, reduces shipping times, and maximizes inventory turnover.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR supports business decisions on allocating orders to specific stores based on stock depth, implying a need for a dynamic allocation logic.

business_requirements.name: Inventory Data Integrity and Validation
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall validate inventory data against defined thresholds and consistency rules before using it for business decisions to ensure data reliability.
business_requirements.business_objective: Ensure that all inventory data used for order processing is accurate, fresh, and consistent with physical reality.
business_requirements.business_value: Reduces operational errors, prevents financial loss from incorrect pricing or allocation, and maintains system integrity.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR explicitly requires information validation, including non-negative integers, latency thresholds, and consistency with physical counts.

origin.description: The current, validated quantity of each sellable item (SKU) at a specific store location, including status flags for availability, partial stock, or temporary unavailability.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of inventory records passing validation checks
Latency compliance rate for data freshness

policies_and_constraints: Quantity values must be non-negative integers for sellable items.
Last sync timestamp must be within acceptable latency thresholds.
Status flags must be consistent with physical inventory counts.
Data must originate from the store's Point of Sale system.
Outdated inventory data must be flagged or rejected before use.
assumptions: Store POS systems can provide valid timestamps.
Latency thresholds are defined and enforceable.
risks_and_dependencies: Inconsistent status flags causing allocation errors.
Dependency on Store Partner POS system health.

business_requirements.name: Customer Expectation Management
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall present accurate product selection options to customers based on actual inventory levels to manage expectations and prevent purchase failures.
business_requirements.business_objective: Ensure customers only see and attempt to purchase items that are physically available.
business_requirements.business_value: Improves customer satisfaction, reduces support tickets related to out-of-stock items, and enhances brand trust.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR states that the information is consumed by the Customer Interface to manage customer expectations and prevent overselling.

business_requirements.name: Dynamic Pricing and Promotion Adjustment
business_requirements.business_requirement: The system shall initiate dynamic pricing or promotion adjustments for low-stock items based on real-time inventory status.
business_requirements.business_objective: Optimize revenue and inventory turnover by adjusting prices for items nearing stockout.
business_requirements.business_value: Increases revenue from high-demand low-stock items and accelerates inventory clearance.
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The IR supports business decisions on initiating dynamic pricing or promotion adjustments for low-stock items.
